name: mcp-data-europa
what_it_holds: MCP server providing a client for data.europa.eu, the official EU open-data hub (~1.6M datasets). TypeScript. Last updated 13 Sep 2026 (one day before this scout ran).
why_useful: A maintained, current client for the EU's central data catalogue (DCAT-based) — useful for finding EU member-state tourism, mobility, or STR-regulation datasets referenced in gaps 7 and 12 (EU DAC7 platform reporting, national tourism-board series) without manual portal-by-portal search.
themes: Open-data portal discovery: Socrata/CKAN/data.gov/EU data portal clients, dataset search tools, Google Dataset Search scrapers; city portals with STR datasets
why_all: A maintained, current client for the EU's central data catalogue (DCAT-based) — useful for finding EU member-state tourism, mobility, or STR-regulation datasets referenced in gaps 7 and 12 (EU DAC7 platform reporting, national tourism-board series) without manual portal-by-portal search.

name: Auctus
what_it_holds: NYU academic dataset-search engine and crawler (mirror of gitlab.com/ViDA-NYU/auctus); indexes and profiles datasets from Socrata and Zenodo (among other plugins) into an Elasticsearch-backed catalog with a public API (auctus.vida-nyu.org) and React UI for join/union-based data augmentation. Apache-2.0, 2,771 commits.
why_useful: A live, hosted, general-purpose dataset search engine spanning Socrata portals plus Zenodo — could surface STR/tourism/lodging datasets across many US cities' Socrata instances that a manual per-city search would miss; also directly matches the theme's 'dataset search tools' remit.
themes: Open-data portal discovery: Socrata/CKAN/data.gov/EU data portal clients, dataset search tools, Google Dataset Search scrapers; city portals with STR datasets
why_all: A live, hosted, general-purpose dataset search engine spanning Socrata portals plus Zenodo — could surface STR/tourism/lodging datasets across many US cities' Socrata instances that a manual per-city search would miss; also directly matches the theme's 'dataset search tools' remit.

name: awesome-public-datasets
what_it_holds: The master curated catalogue itself (auto-generated from awesomedata/apd-core YAML metadata files), organized into ~35 sections (Agriculture, Economics, Finance, GIS, Government, SocialNetworks, SocialSciences, Transportation, etc.), each with dozens to hundreds of dataset links, mostly to external hosts (many recently-added entries are small commercial SEO-style 'open dataset' pages rather than research-grade data - the catalogue quality has degraded with many low-value submissions circa 2026, alongside legitimate long-standing entries like OpenFlights, RITA/BTS TranStat, Skytrax reviews, and Uber TLC data).
why_useful: Fastest way to sweep for a free source we have not seen yet on gaps 6-13 (regional travel volume, hotel supply, housing/rental, consumer spend); worth a targeted re-read of its Transportation/Economics/Real-Estate sections rather than a full dataset in itself.
size_hint: README index only, no data files in this repo
themes: Awesome lists and curated catalogues: awesome-public-datasets, awesome-alternative-data, awesome-quant data, awesome-economics, awesome-tourism, awesome-real-estate, awesome-transportation-data
why_all: Fastest way to sweep for a free source we have not seen yet on gaps 6-13 (regional travel volume, hotel supply, housing/rental, consumer spend); worth a targeted re-read of its Transportation/Economics/Real-Estate sections rather than a full dataset in itself.

Serves as a standing discovery index worth periodic re-scanning (per gap 17's spirit of open-data discovery tooling), but as of this pass it surfaced no committed Airbnb/STR/tourism-specific datasets beyond what is separately flagged; most new entries are unrelated commercial price-index microsites.

name: awesome-quant
what_it_holds: 29.5k-star flagship quant-finance resource list, updated same-day. Confirmed sections: Alternative Data & Sentiment (news/social sentiment tools), Economic & Macro Data (OmniOracle: 500+ series from FRED/World Bank/EIA/NOAA; pystlouisfed and fedfred: Python clients for FRED, ALFRED, GeoFRED and FRASER -- i.e. vintage/point-in-time macro data; treasurydirect, treasury-fiscaldata, newyorkfed, commitments-of-traders TypeScript API clients; estat-mcp for Japanese e-Stat data), Point-in-Time & Vintage Data Tools (ashare-data-immunity, pit-adjuster -- China A-share point-in-time adjustment, not US-relevant), and Institutional/Corporate Filings (edgartools, SECfinAPI, edinetdb/edinet-mcp for Japanese XBRL filings).
why_useful: pystlouisfed / fedfred give a maintained Python client to FRED's ALFRED (archival vintage) service, which is exactly the 'ALFRED-style macro vintages' asked for in gap 4; estat-mcp is a ready client for Japanese government statistics (GDP/CPI/trade) relevant to gap 7 APAC volume.
size_hint: README index; linked clients are small pip/npm packages
duplicate_of_holding: FRED is already held (non-vintage); ALFRED vintages via pystlouisfed/fedfred would be new
themes: Awesome lists and curated catalogues: awesome-public-datasets, awesome-alternative-data, awesome-quant data, awesome-economics, awesome-tourism, awesome-real-estate, awesome-transportation-data
why_all: pystlouisfed / fedfred give a maintained Python client to FRED's ALFRED (archival vintage) service, which is exactly the 'ALFRED-style macro vintages' asked for in gap 4; estat-mcp is a ready client for Japanese government statistics (GDP/CPI/trade) relevant to gap 7 APAC volume.

name: machine-learning-for-trading
what_it_holds: Companion code repo for the "Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading" book. Chapter 4 ("Fundamental and Alternative Data") documents point-in-time SEC EDGAR pipelines, entity resolution across identifier systems, macro/commodity fundamentals, and alternative-data evaluation frameworks (including newer additions like on-chain/prediction-market data). Earlier editions of this repo are widely known to include an OpenTable scraping chapter and other alt-data acquisition notebooks (Twitter/SEC filings/Seeking Alpha) though the current README summary did not enumerate a travel-specific scraper by name.
why_useful: General-purpose, well-maintained reference implementation for gap #17 (point-in-time SEC EDGAR tooling, alt-data evaluation methodology) that we could adapt directly rather than build from scratch.
license: unconfirmed (book companion, check for reuse terms)
themes: Company KPI and alt-data backtest repos for ABNB or OTAs: anyone who already assembled Airbnb quarterly KPI datasets, consensus, or alt-data panels
